'''Abors''' is an [[Asha'man]] who is one of [[Mazrim Taim]]'s [[Dreadlords]]. He did not need to be [[Turning|Turned]] to the Shadow. He was one of those who had gone to Taim willingly. {{ref/book|14|10}}

== Activities ==
Abors helps bring in [[Toveine Gazal]]. He is charged by Taim to Turn her before he gets back. When Androl's [[Forkroot]] dose was lowered so he can be [[Turning|Turned]], he held a shield on him.   

== Death ==
Androl used his knowledge of Evin's madness to make Evin attack and kill Abors.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Abors}} He told Evin that he overheard Abors talking about how he did not like Evin being Turned and Abors thinks that Evin wants to take his place and he might plan to kill Evin. When Abors is struck with the [[One Power]] Androl's shield was dropped so that he could save [[Logain Ablar|Logain]] from being Turned. Of Abors there was nothing much left than a smoking corpse.
